refined_prompt: A tray of golden fried spring rolls with fresh herbs and dipping sauce. A tray filled with crispy and golden fried spring rolls, known as "nem rán" in Vietnamese cuisine. Each roll is delicately wrapped in translucent rice paper, filled with ground pork and a mix of fresh vegetables like carrots and mung bean sprouts. These rolls are typically served alongside a variety of fresh herbs such as Thai basil and mint, as well as a savory dipping sauce made from fish sauce, sugar, and lime juice.
